assignment.title: Project 2: Campus Food Finder
assignment.descriptionText:
In teams of 4 to 6, design and build a small web application that helps students find open food options on campus.
Requirements:
1. Interview at least 5 students and write a 1 page summary.
2. Requirements document with at least 10 user stories and acceptance criteria.
3. Wireframes for at least 4 screens and a clickable mockup.
4. Working prototype (React or similar) with a searchable list of food locations and their hours.
5. Load and clean the provided dining hours CSV and expose it through a simple API.
6. Unit tests for search and hours logic, at least 70 percent coverage.
7. 6 to 8 page final report on design decisions, testing, and reflections.
8. 10 minute in-class presentation with a live demo.
Deliverables: GitHub repo link with README, final report PDF, presentation slides.

criteria.name: Implementation
ratings: Search and hours work end to end

attachments.text: Dining hours CSV columns: location, day, open, close. Times are local (MST). Some rows have missing close times; treat them as closed.
